frozen.question: What do Samsung Galaxy Note 9 owners say about how long a charge lasts?

chunks.text: Battery Life is a killer. Phone looks great barring the smallest of imperfections on the case. It's a real bummer that the battery doesn't make it through the day though. Although there's a huge (4,000 mah) battery in this phone, I struggle to get to 5PM without having to recharge it. But, that's the price of saving $700 to 800 buying used.
battery life. nice phone but battery life is atrocious.
Battery life is very poor. It's nice but battery life is not good it last me day for a new phone I should get a refund back
The battery life the worst thing in that phone other wise good for the price. Battery life the worst thing in that phone
Great battery life. Really enjoying the phone... the battery life is fantastic!
Great battery life. A very beautiful phone. Battery life is one of the best I have ever had in a Samsung phone
It ok just to say it sticking. Battery life is ok

Lower your expectation on Note 9' battery life.. Accordingly to other reviews the battery of Note 9 should last longer but it is worse than the Note 4's battery. It does charge faster but certainly does not last longer.

I'm a little disappointed in the battery life on this, but I'm guessing it wasn't replaced while being refurbished. Samsung and tech reviews seem to brag on battery life, which again, doesn't compare to the Huawei.

I have had Samsung Notes since the very beginning. I do like this phone, the battery life is great, charges well with cordless charging. As a veteran Samsung Galaxy Note user, I would say, this is a good phone.
